Variants.Content: Ctesiphon and Mesopotamian irrigation supply court and armies, with estates, gifts and routes linking the plateau. Canals, labor and transport sustain income; excess collection damages continued provision.

Ctesiphon and Mesopotamian irrigation supply Sasanian tax grain. Traveling followers need real food from this production; valuables still require a buyer and exchange. Canals, labor and transport sustain continued revenue.
